description: This PHP class 'DetailedPerformanceReviewModel' serves as a data model for detailed performance reviews within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities, relies on traits for service access, and defines properties corresponding to a performance review entity, including job title, subunit, review period, due date, and overall status. It primarily provides a constructor for setting up the model and a toArray method that includes self-review status information.

classes.name: DetailedPerformanceReviewModel
classes.description: A data transfer object representing detailed performance review data, capable of normalization and serialization, with properties mapped to performance review entity fields and additional review status info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PerformanceReview entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the model's data as an array, augmenting it with the self-review status retrieved from the performance review service.
